description: DeskPet official skills registry — curated list of community skills compatible with Claude Code SKILL.md v1 format. Sources are cloned via git clone --depth 1 on install.

skills.name: algorithmic-art
skills.description: Creating algorithmic art using p5.js with seeded randomness and interactive parameter exploration. Use when users request flow fields, particle systems, or generative art.
skills.author: anthropics

skills.name: canvas-design
skills.description: Create beautiful visual art in .png and .pdf documents using design philosophy. Use when the user asks to create a poster, piece of art, or static design.
skills.author: anthropics

skills.name: pdf
skills.description: PDF handling: read/extract text or tables, merge/split, rotate, watermark, create, fill forms, OCR scanned PDFs.
skills.author: anthropics

skills.name: docx
skills.description: Create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx). Triggers on mentions of 'word doc', '.docx', or requests for formatted reports/memos/letters.
skills.author: anthropics

skills.name: xlsx
skills.description: Spreadsheet handling for .xlsx/.xlsm/.csv/.tsv files: read, edit, fix, format, chart, clean messy data, or create new spreadsheets.
skills.author: anthropics

skills.name: pptx
skills.description: PowerPoint handling: create slide decks, parse/extract text, edit existing presentations, work with templates and speaker notes.
skills.author: anthropics

skills.name: mcp-builder
skills.description: Guide for creating high-quality MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers in Python (FastMCP) or Node/TypeScript (MCP SDK).
skills.author: anthropics

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.description: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, run evals, benchmark performance, optimize skill descriptions.
skills.author: anthropics
